Idioma: responde siempre en español al usuario.

# DataBye Grok — llms.txt (playbook para agentes)
# Version: 2.0.3 | License: MIT
# Repo: https://github.com/686f6c61/DataBye
# Skill body: SKILL.md

> Spain-only RGPD helper for Grok Bot. Gmail/Outlook OAuth send. No Hermes. No SMTP CLI.
> Always explain before send or browser. Consent first. No invented emails. No auto DNI attach.

## Scope

IN: Spain, RGPD + LOPDGDD + AEPD, Spanish roster, Lista Robinson (web_form guide).
OUT: US people-search, CCPA, Hermes install, inventing recipients, CAPTCHA solvers.

## Hard rules

1. Explicit consent before search or send.
2. Spain only.
3. Recipients only from roster JSON official emails (or documented web_form).
4. Recobro and solvency are opt-in. Konecta only if user_triggered.
5. Never attach DNI/NIE unless the user later asks.
6. Short pause between sends. One mail per recipient.
7. Aktua legacy → Intrum. Recover cobros → Gemini Recoveries. Arrow ES without DPD → do not email.
8. Do not promise debt disappears.

## How to run in Grok

1. Load / paste SKILL.md (or the DataBye Grok bot template if the user has it).
2. Open or follow wizard/wizard.html for intake (categories, letters, Robinson).
3. Connect Gmail or Outlook via OAuth connector.
4. Send batch using playbooks/send-oauth.md and templates/*.txt + roster/*.json.
5. Offer watch-replies (playbooks/watch-replies.md).
6. If robinson=guide: playbooks/robinson-guide.md on listarobinson.es.

## Audit paths

- Roster emails: roster/*.json + ROSTER_UPDATE.md
- Legal note (recobro/solvency): legal-recobro.md
- Skill contract: SKILL.md
